grammar.title: 论述
lines: 4 Up to now , historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture , for then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons . come into being 开始存在 To be or not to be , that is the question. — William Shakespeare 'Hamlet' the advent of sth. / sb. 某事/某人的出现（重大事件、重要人物） with the evidence began to accumulate ... With 是介词，后面需要跟名词，不能直接跟句子。 Recent scientific evidence seems to indicate that this assumption is incorrect . indicate v. 表明，表示 Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths . be puzzled by ... 对...感觉迷惑不解 造句：Doctors have long been puzzled by the rare skin condition. 医生们长久以来对这种罕见的皮肤病感到困惑。 ivory n.象牙，（其他动物的）长牙；象牙制品(不可数名词) The nomads who made these markings lived by hunting and fishing during the last Ice Age which began about 35,000 B.C. and ended about 10,000 B.C . live by doing sth. 做某事为生 age An age is a period in history. 时代 造句：Laozi, legendary founder of Daoism , lived by taking charge of the royal library during the late Spring and Autumn Period which began about 600 B.C. and ended about 500 B.C . 传说中道教的创始人老子，生活 在大约公元前6世纪至公元前5世纪春秋时代的晚期，靠掌管国家图书馆为生。 By correlating markings made in various parts of the world , historians have been able to read this difficult code . in various parts of the world 世界各地 They have found that it is connected with the passage of days and the phases of the moon . the phases of the moon 月相（圆缺） With joy and woe people meet and part 人有悲欢离合 With light and shade the moon waxes and wanes 月有阴晴圆缺 Since time immemorial it's been unchanged 此事古难全 Would that we could live a long life 但愿人长久 And together share the moonlight though thousands of miles apart 千里共婵娟 It is , in fact , a primitive type of calendar . It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression . They had a definite meaning , for they were as near as early man could get to writing . definite adj.清晰的，明晰的；确定的，不会改变的；肯定的，一定的 get to doing sth. = start doing sth. 开始做某事 It is possible that there is a definite relation between these paintings and the markings that sometimes accompany them . accompany v.陪伴，陪同；伴随 It seems that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed . 主系表 make an effort to do sth. 努力做某事 每日习语 lose one's heart to sb. 倾心于某人
I think therefore I am . — René Descartes
come into fashion 开始流行 However, a new type of humour, which stems largely from the U.S., has recently come into fashion .
come into use 开始得到了使用 The new software will come into use next month. 新软件将于下个月开始使用。
come into effect 开始产生效果 The new law will come into effect at the beginning of next year. 新法律将于明年年初生效。
come into blossom 开花 The cherry trees will come into blossom in the spring. 樱花树将在春天开花。
The advent of the steam engine heralded the beginning of a new era.
The advent of the internet has changed the way we communicate. 互联网的出现改变了我们的交流方式。
The advent of the new CEO brought significant changes to the company. 新任CEO的到来给公司带来了重大变化。
with the advent of ... 随着...的到来 With the advent of the new chairman, the company began to prosper.
with the coming of ... 随着...的到来 With the coming of spring, the days become longer and warmer. 随着春天的到来，白天变得更长更暖。
with the arrival of ... 随着...的到来 With the arrival of the new technology, our work has become easier. 随着新技术的到来，我们的工作变得更轻松。
with the birth of ... 随着...的诞生 With the birth of her child, her life changed completely. 随着孩子的出生，她的生活发生了巨大的变化。
with the genesis of ... 随着...的起源、创造 With the genesis of the new project, many opportunities arose. 随着新项目的启动，出现了许多机会。
with the approach of Christmas 随着圣诞节的临近 With the approach of Christmas , the streets are decorated with lights. 随着圣诞节的临近，街道上装饰着灯光。
with the outbreak of war 随着战争的爆发 With the outbreak of war , many families were displaced. 随着战争的爆发，许多家庭流离失所。
with the progress of science 随着科学的进步 With the progress of science , many diseases can now be cured. 随着科学的进步，许多疾病现在可以治愈了。
I shook my head and held up five fingers indicating that I was willing to pay £ 5 .
A survey of retired people has indicated that most are independent and enjoying life. 一项对退休人员的调查表明，他们中的大部分人生活自立而愉快。
Our vote today indicates a change in United States policy. 我们今天的投票表明了美国政策的变化。
She was puzzled by the strange message. 她对那条奇怪的信息感到困惑。
be perplexed by ... 对...感觉困惑 He was perplexed by the sudden change in her behavior. 他对她行为的突然变化感到困惑。
be baffled by ... 对...感觉困惑 The scientists were baffled by the unexpected results of the experiment. 科学家们对实验的意外结果感到困惑。
has long been known that 长期以来就知道 It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression.
has long been believed that 长期以来就相信 It has long been believed that cats have nine lives. 人们长期以来相信猫有九条命。

has long been a superstition that 长久以来有一种迷信认为 There has long been a superstition among mariners that porpoises will save drowning men by pushing them to the surface, or protect them from sharks by surrounding them in efensive formation. NCE4-18 There has long been a superstition among the Chinese that seeing a magpie will bring you good luck / is a good omen / is an auspicious omen . 中国人长久以来迷信看见 喜鹊 会有好运气。 There has long been a superstition among the Chinese that hearing the crowing of a crow is an ominous omen .
three ivory tusk s 三根象牙(转为可数)
ivory tower 象牙塔
It has been said that everyone lives by selling something .
He makes a living by teaching music . 他以教音乐为生。
They live by fishing in the local rivers. 他们靠在当地河流捕鱼为生。
... the age of steam and steel. …蒸汽与钢铁时代。
the Ice / Stone Age 固定搭配
the modern age
the computer age
time (历史上或一生中的特殊) 时期 Roman times in modern / recent / ancient / prehistoric times 在现代/近代/古代/史前时代
era 时代 the end of an era the beginning of a new era
Cooked in wine, snails are a great luxury in various parts of the world .
At present, they are visiting all parts of the country .
... tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it .
Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world .
He's only forty-one years old,and he has already been to nearly every country in the world .
...the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C .
wax and wane 周期性变化
depict v.描绘，描画 a picture depicting him as a clown
v.描写 The novel depicts French society in the 1930s.
a definite answer
a definite meaning
definite article 定冠词（The）
indefinite adj.无限期的，期限不定的；模糊不清的，不明确的 indefinite article 不定冠词(a,an) an indefinite prison term 无限期监禁(无期徒刑)
definitive adj.最终的，确定的；最好的 a definitive judgment 终审 a definitive diagnosis 确诊 a definitive guide book 权威指南
finite adj.有限的，有限制的；限定的 Human knowledge is finite .
infinite adj.无限的，无穷尽的 The universe is infinite .
infinitive n.（动词的）不定式 It is wrong to ever split an infinitive . 将不定式分割永远是错误的。
He got to thinking that it was all his fault.
Once we got to cooking , we realized we were missing some ingredients. 一旦我们开始做饭，就意识到缺少一些食材。
She started studying as soon as she got home. 她一回家就开始学习(start doing sth.)。
Having left the bag in the hall, I accompanied Robert into the living room.
The disease is accompanied by sneezing and fever.
He made an effort to finish the project on time. 他努力按时完成项目。
spare no effort to do sth. 不遗余力地做某事 China will spare no effort to realize peaceful reunification.
